configuration.natural_growth: Each new point is maximal in the existing prefix; its declared predecessor set is a down-set. Natural labels are bookkeeping, not physical time.

memory_at_prefix: complete prefix vertex set with declared boundary/interior roles
complete transitive causal relation of the prefix
all retained clock T, density r and scalar q variables
the joint conditional amplitude, including all correlations

history identity until the explicitly chosen final coherent or resolved readout
new_point_rule: For each stored ancestor y and new point x, count stored z with y<z<x, cap at4 for the coefficient. Multiply by the exact new endpoint action factor. Copy the full earlier memory without independent averaging.
memory_is_not_a_detector: History identity is computational bookkeeping, not an extra orthogonal apparatus flag; final coherent summation is kept when required by the record contract.

measure_ownership.interior_clock: Each of 4,5,6 integrated once with dT/3 on[-3/2,3/2]
measure_ownership.interior_density: Each of 4,5,6 integrated once with(delta0+1_(0,1)dr)/2; all8strata remain
measure_ownership.boundary_clock_density: Fixed by parent contract, not separately integrated
measure_ownership.boundary_scalar: Common Gaussian pi^(-2)exp(-sum_B q^2/2) inserted once; dq_B integrated once
measure_ownership.interior_scalar: Lebesgue dq_I, each with one exp(-epsilon*q_j^2/2)
measure_ownership.quotient_factor: No factor2 or new seam quotient introduced
measure_ownership.history_weights: Each omega_C inserted once; no sequential growth prior is derived

composition: T_c:b composed with T_b:a equals T_c:a by identity-memory copying and addition of endpoint actions. Final integration of each original field happens once.
finite_regulator: For epsilon>0 the common scalarGaussian and three interiorAbel factors make the joint finite-dimensional integral absolutely integrable; finite clock/density measures allow Fubini grouping.
zero_regulator: Take epsilon to0 only after the common boundary test pairing; do not compose separately taken singular limits.

geometry_history_observable.definition: Number of comparable unordered pairs among interior{4,5,6}
geometry_history_observable.scope: Invariant combinatorial history functional; not radius, curvature, physical proper time or a probability distribution.
